standard_prerequisites.name: Noetherian approximation: schemes, bounded finitely presented complexes, their flatness, properness of support, and perfect objects all descend from a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings after enlarging the index, by the Limits descent lemmas
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the Noetherian model X_i, G_i^bullet, E_i over R_i to which the Noetherian case applies.

core_obligations: Cite the base change lemma so only perfection of K remains; note that if S is Noetherian the result is the Noetherian internal-Hom lemma, and set up the Noetherian approximation reduction (proof lines 7856-7861).

Localize so S = Spec(R) affine and write R as a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings R_i; descend X to an X_i of finite presentation over R_i, then, after increasing i, descend the bounded finitely presented complex G^bullet to G_i^bullet, its flatness over R_i, the properness of its support over R_i, and finally the perfect object E to a perfect E_i (proof lines 7864-7883).

Apply the Noetherian internal-Hom lemma to X_i over Spec(R_i) with E_i and G_i^bullet, then use the base change property already established to transfer the conclusion back along the base change to R, obtaining that K is perfect and commutes with base change (proof lines 7884-7886).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the Noetherian case via the base change lemma and the Noetherian internal-Hom lemma (proof lines 7856-7861).
Descend the datum over the filtered colimit R = colim R_i with the Limits lemmas (proof lines 7864-7883).
Apply the Noetherian case to the descended datum and conclude by base change (proof lines 7884-7886).
